captions.ig:
Someone texts "how much?" Answer in one text, in 4 parts.

1. Lead with the real price. If it truly depends, give your starting price and what changes it.
2. Say what is included and how long it takes.
3. Offer two real times you have open.
4. End on one question that books it.

The Claude prompt is on slide 6. Sample business shown is made up.

Comment AGENTS and we will DM you the free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice. It drafts, you send.

Sources: WeddingPro, Greenlit Content, Readymode, Bloom.

#smallbusiness #doggroomer #customerservice #pricing #claudeai
